name: "누구에게 무엇을 주다" 💬 헷갈리는 영어 문장 구성 | give something to someone? / give someone something

keywords.ko: 무엇이 it으로 대체될 경우 give it to 누구
무엇이 무엇그대로 나올 경우 give 누구 무엇

keywords.en: I gave it to my mom.

keywords.ko: 누구한테 (무엇=it)을 줬다. : gave it  to 누구 (gave my mom it)
무엇을 대명사(it, them)[지시대명사 that those, this 말고] 를 할경우 대명사가 먼저 나와야함.

keywords.en: Oh, You lent it to her?
No, I just gave it to her.
You gave your mom your car?

keywords.ko: → 여태까지는 다 대명사로 하다가 확실하게 확인하고 싶어서 다 정확하게 물어보는 거라
⇒ 대명사가 아닐 때는 해당 문장처럼 사용해야 함

keywords.en: B: I gave it to my mom
A: You lent it to her?
B: No I just gave it to her
A: You gave your mom your car?
A: No I was just curious.

my_sentences.ko: 1. give + 사람 + 물건 (가장 많이 쓰는 형태)
give + 사람 + 물건 :누구에게 무엇을 주다
I gave my mom my car. 엄마에게 내 차를 드렸다.
She gave me a gift. 그녀가 나에게 선물을 줬다.
Can you give me your phone? 휴대폰 좀 줄래?
My dad gave me some advice. 아버지가 나에게 조언을 해주셨다.
I'll give you another chance. 한 번 더 기회를 줄게.
She gave her son some money. 아들에게 돈을 좀 줬다.
They gave us free tickets. 우리에게 무료 티켓을 줬다.
2.  give + 물건 + to + 사람

my_sentences.en: I gave my car to my mom.
my_sentences.ko: give + 물건 + to + 사람 : 조금 더 강조하거나 목적어가 길 때 자주 사용합니다.

my_sentences.en: She gave the present to me.
He gave the book to his sister.
We gave the tickets to our friends.
They gave the money to charity.
I'll give this to you later.
my_sentences.ko: 3. 대명사(it, them)는 반드시 앞!

my_sentences.en: I gave it to my mom.
She gave them to me.
He gave it to us.
Can you give it to him?
Please give them to your teacher.
my_sentences.ko: ❌ 틀린 표현

my_sentences.en: I gave my mom it.
She gave me them.
my_sentences.ko: it / them 같은 대명사는 항상 동사 바로 뒤에 옵니다.
4. 연습 ① (한국어 → 영어)
① 엄마한테 줬어. → I gave it to my mom.
② 동생한테 줬어. → I gave it to my brother.
③ 선생님께 드렸어요. → I gave it to my teacher.
④ 걔한테 다 줬어.→ I gave them to him.
⑤ 친구한테 보냈어. → I gave it to my friend.
(※ send도 같은 구조입니다.)
5. 연습 ② (give 사람 물건)
① 엄마에게 차를 드렸어. → I gave my mom my car.
② 친구에게 책을 줬어.→ I gave my friend the book.
③ 아들에게 돈을 줬어. → I gave my son some money.
④ 그녀에게 꽃을 줬어. → I gave her some flowers.
⑤ 아이들에게 사탕을 줬어. → I gave the kids some candy.

my_sentences.en: ①I gave my mom my car. →I gave it to my mom.
my_sentences.ko: 6. give → it으로 바꾸는 연습

my_sentences.en: ②She gave me the book. →She gave it to me.
③ We gave our friends the tickets. →We gave them to our friends.
④ My dad gave me some money.→ He gave it to me.
my_sentences.ko: 7. lend도 똑같은 구조

my_sentences.en: I lent my brother my car.
my_sentences.ko: lend + 사람 + 물건

my_sentences.en: She lent me her laptop.
my_sentences.ko: lend + 물건 + to + 사람

my_sentences.en: I lent my car to my brother.
She lent her laptop to me.
my_sentences.ko: 대명사

my_sentences.en: I lent it to him.
She lent it to me.
We lent them to our neighbors.
